subject.title: fix(crabbox): preserve UTF-16 boundaries in CLI failure detail truncation

question: Should this PR wait for redacted output from an installed Crabbox failure, or should the deterministic source reproduction and provider-path tests receive a proof override?
rationale: No functional or security defect remains in the patch, but repository policy requires after-fix real-setup evidence for an external PR and the contributor reports they cannot produce it in their environment.

options.title: Capture installed proof
options.body: Run an installed Crabbox warmup, inspect, or stop failure on the exact PR head and attach redacted output showing the resulting message has no lone surrogate.

options.title: Approve proof override
options.body: Explicitly accept the deterministic boundary reproduction and provider-path regression tests as sufficient for this narrowly observable formatting fix.

recommendation.title: Capture installed proof
recommendation.body: Run an installed Crabbox warmup, inspect, or stop failure on the exact PR head and attach redacted output showing the resulting message has no lone surrogate.

likelyOwner.reason: The live PR is assigned to the feature owner, who also authored the latest refinement and has recent ownership of the shared helper.
